definitions.explanation: A person or family that engages in farming; also refers to the farmhouse itself.

examples.japanese: {農家|のうか}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I buy vegetables directly from farmers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{農家|のうか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather grew up on a farm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{農家|のうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
USAGE: {農家|のうか} can refer to (1) a farmer/farming family, or (2) a farmhouse.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {農家|のうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (farmer)
- {農家|のうか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧ (to grow up on a farm)
- {農家|のうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{営|いとな}む→営む：11837_itonamu⟧ (to run a farm)
- {農家|のうか}⟦{直送|ちょくそう}→直送：13824_chokusou⟧ (direct from the farm)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{農民|のうみん}→農民：03759_noumin⟧ - farmer, peasant (more emphasis on the person)
- ⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧ - agriculture, farming
- ⟦{農村|のうそん}→農村：04292_nouson⟧ - farming village
- ⟦{農地|のうち}→農地：14354_nouchi⟧ - farmland
- ⟦{専業|せんぎょう}→専業：15394_sengyou⟧{農家|のうか} - full-time farmer
- ⟦{兼業|けんぎょう}→兼業：08562_kengyou⟧{農家|のうか} - part-time farmer
